description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，默认值为1，取值范围为1~100。
description.en: The page number of the returned results to display. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，默认值为10，最大值不超过100。
description.en: The number of records displayed per page in the returned results. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh: 传入数据源名称中任意字符串，根据该字符串检索能匹配的数据源名称。
description.en: A string contained in the data source name. The system retrieves data source names that match this string.

title.zh: 查询解析器数据源列表
title.en: Query the list of Resolver data sources

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot list-parser-data-source --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --page-size 10 --search-name DataSource --page 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
